notes: Discovery notes from 2026-02-18: Emberlane builds agent desktop and routing intelligence for 20+ telco and fintech CX customers.
Primary ask: real-time streaming agent suggestions (token-level suggestions) integrated into their agent UI and desktop tool-calls into Zendesk + internal CRM.
Latency target: product wants p95 < 60ms for suggestion token arrival and p99 < 180ms under typical traffic; VP Ops said 'we can't tolerate >200ms tail during peak'.
Throughput: 1.2k concurrent agents in busiest region; spikes expected during product launches and billing cycles (3x baseline).
Quality guardrails: hallucination suppression, citation to ticket history, automated refusal templates for PII requests, user-edit logging for audit
Model preferences: open to Mistral/LLama-3 variants that Redwood verifies; want fallback on smaller quantized variant for cost-sensitive routing.
Data controls: must keep transcripts for 90 days in-region; long-term retention optional behind customer's KMS; need audit logs for all model calls.
Quote from VP of Support: 'If suggestions slow the agent down we lose trust — latency is table stakes; accuracy and traceability are next.'
Procurement notes: legal wants standard DPA + SOC2 evidence; security team submitted questionnaire (see drive doc).
Sales angle: strong fit for Dedicated with Optimize recommendations to manage token spend and batching; Private deployment requested for select regulated customers.

poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): deploy Dedicated pod with model variant A (high-accuracy) + streaming API into Emberlane QA environment; validate token-level latency and suggestion correctness.
Phase 2 (1 week): run synthetic spike tests (1k -> 3k concurrent agents) to validate autoscaling and graceful degradation (fallback to quantized variant).
Phase 3 (2 weeks): integrate tool-calling stub into Zendesk sandbox (create/update tickets, add internal notes) and verify idempotency & audit logs.
Success criteria: p95 suggestion latency < 60ms, p99 < 180ms at baseline; no dropped suggestions during 3x spikes; tool-calls succeed with ACID-like guarantees in 99.9% of ops.
technical_requirements: Streaming SSE/websocket endpoint for per-token suggestions; ability to subscribe/unsubscribe per-agent session.
Per-customer KV caching and prefix caching for recent ticket context (TTL configurable).
Model pinning and rollout APIs to test A/B between high-accuracy and quantized cost-saving variants.
Tracing hooks and token-level cost reporting to feed into Emberlane dashboards and Redwood Console.
Built-in rate-limiting, request prioritization (agent-tier vs batch jobs), and regional routing controls.
